verdict.rationale: vLLM is installed and run locally (pip/uv, build from source) and supports a wide range of local hardware (NVIDIA/AMD GPUs, x86/ARM CPUs, Apple Silicon), with a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API server, meaning inference and data stay on the user's own machine. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement on data privacy/no telemetry, independent hands-on confirmation of fully offline operation, and documentation of any external calls (e.g., model download telemetry) that could leak metadata.
